description: Marketing Automation trackEvent calls posted to in-automate.brevo.com. The JavaScript tracker on sibautomation.com is a different surface and is not contracted here.

params.name: email
params.description: Brevo identifies the contact by email on every REST trackEvent call.

params.name: event
params.description: It is the event name to record. Any value is legal except the reserved keys inside `properties`.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to the name you want in Automation, such as `cart_updated`.

params.name: properties
params.description: Optional contact properties. Do not put `email` or `event` inside this object; those keys are reserved.

params.name: eventdata
params.description: Optional event payload, such as cart contents under `eventdata.data`.
